name: 10k Rotary Potentiometer
description: Like a physical volume knob! Creates a smooth voltage divider from 0 to 5 volts as you turn it.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a physical volume knob! Creates a smooth voltage divider from 0 to 5 volts as you turn it.
wiringGuidance: Connect left pin 1 to 5V (Red), right pin 3 to GND (Dark Slate), and center wiper pin 2 to analog pin A0 (Yellow).
commonMistakes: Connecting center wiper to 5V and outer pins to GND (creates a direct dead short when turned fully!).
Forcing the shaft beyond its ~270 degree mechanical limits.

miniExperiment.title: Rotary Voltage Gauge
miniExperiment.circuit: Pin 1 to 5V, Pin 2 to A0, Pin 3 to GND.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Rotating the knob smoothly shifts readings from 0 (0.00V) to 1023 (5.00V).
